. CONCLUSIONS In this work, fast ionic conductors in the solid state, based on the LiBH4−MgO system, were investigated. The samples were mechanochemically synthetized. The Li-ion conductivity of LiBH4 was improved in all cases, and the samples containing 53 v/v % of MgO showed the best enhancement (2.86 × 10−4 S cm−1 at 20 °C), since the volume fraction of LiBH4 allowed to completely ﬁll the pore volume of MgO.
